provisional_note: PROVISIONAL: based on 1200 scored held-out test games (2400 sides), not the full ~2,700-game stratified sample (bullet/blitz/rapid target ~600 each, classical/ultrabullet take their whole pool). The full run was stopped early for a scheduling reason and is queued to resume; this file will be regenerated and this flag cleared when it completes. Treat per-time-control cutoffs for any bucket below the sides threshold as unstable estimates.
source_description: Stratified sample of held-out TEST-partition games from the thesis corpus (analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv on the HPC checkout), scored with the exact model + AnomalyDetector code path the RatingNet web prototype uses. The model never trained on these games.
note: These cutoffs describe how S_att is distributed across ordinary, finished, rated human games in the held-out test set. They are not a cheat-detection threshold: in thesis evaluation S_att separated engine-substituted synthetic games only weakly (ROC-AUC 0.555), and a clean synthetic game scored 1097 on this same scale.
